messages:
Maya L.: FYI VertexWorks sent INV-3321 and AP flagged it — no PO on the PDF and they billed the whole amount to Redwood, Inc. but half of the work should be charged to Redwood Labs. Holding payment.
Ethan R.: I see that. Lines: software subscription $9,600; deployment services $4,800. Vendor email mentions PO# 2024-VX-11 but it's not on the invoice.
Nisha P.: 2024-VX-11 exists for the subscription under Redwood Labs, but deployment services werent part of the PO. Who is the cost owner for deployment?
Ethan R.: Deployment is owned by Infra (that's me). I can approve the deployment line but AP needs written approval attached to the invoice record. Also need intercompany mapping for the Labs vs Redwood entities.
Elaine (AP): AP requires: (1) PO attachment to auto-match subscription lines; (2) approver text for the non-PO deployment line; (3) confirmation of legal entity to pay. If VertexWorks billed Redwood, Inc. but part should be charged to Redwood Labs, we need cross-charge code.
Maya L.: Uploaded vendor email that references PO 2024-VX-11, but vendor didn't attach the PO doc. Also added note that VertexWorks billed Redwood, Inc. instead of Redwood Labs.
Ethan R.: Approving deployment: "Ethan R. approves VertexWorks INV-3321 deployment services $4,800, GL=6802, cost center=INFRA-OPS. Internal charge to Redwood Labs entity for subscription lines." Pasting to invoice comment now.
finance-bot: Invoice INV-3321 status updated: "held-no-po" -> "manual-review". Assigned approver: Ethan R. Intercompany flag: required.
Elaine (AP): Good. Maya, please attach PO 2024-VX-11 PDF so AP can auto-match subscription lines. Also confirm the cross-charge memo (code XC-770) and whether vendor will reissue with correct payee.
Maya L.: Attached PO PDF and vendor email screenshot. Vendor says they bill Redwood, Inc. by default and can reissue a corrected invoice if we request it. Ill ask them to reissue to Redwood Labs and include PO 2024-VX-11 on the header.
Ethan R.: Confirm XC-770 mapping is correct for internal charge. I've added the exact cross-charge memo to the invoice note.
Elaine (AP): With PO attached and Ethan's approval note, AP can release the subscription and route the deployment line payment after cross-charge mapping. However, because the vendor applied early payment discount on the gross amount to Redwood, Inc., we need confirmation if discount should be split across entities or applied by vendor on reissue. Who should handle discount allocation?
Maya L.: Good catch. Vendor applied 2% early-pay discount to the full invoice. VertexWorks said they will reflect the discount on the reissued invoice to Redwood Labs and adjust the net. I'll ask them to reissue and confirm allocation.
finance-bot: Invoice INV-3321 status: "manual-review" -> "awaiting-vendor-reissue". Payment hold: true.
Elaine (AP): For now AP will pay the subscription portion matched to PO 2024-VX-11 once vendor confirms reissue or provides written confirmation of discount allocation. Deployment line approved by Ethan and queued for cross-charge. ETA overall resolution: 3 business days after vendor reissue.
Ethan R.: I'll follow up with vendor ops to expedite reissue and confirm discount split.
Maya L.: Noted. I'll track vendor reply and re-open the invoice thread if anything else pops up. Thanks all.
